versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to core functionality or documentation in SKILL.md.

- Initial release of 日期时间格式化服务 (v1.0.0).
- Provides an MCP server for the Claude desktop app to generate date/time strings in multiple formats.
- Requires an API key; prompts user for key on first use if not found in configuration.
- Selects and calls tool functions based on user intent, extracting necessary parameters as needed.
- Includes detailed workflow and strict rules for API key management and tool usage.
- Documents all supported date/time formats and usage instructions in SKILL.md.
